Monthly P&L

Monthly P&L and return

Algo links open the algo's page on stratzy.in (About tab). P&L (₹) = return % × the algo's maximum capital ÷ 100, which is how Stratzy shows it (for example 15.796% on ₹5,00,000 = ₹78,980). Month-wise % is the sum of that month's daily %. Algos traded is the number of algos that have a result for that day. The source data holds one result per algo per day, so individual orders or legs are not counted. In the combined view, ₹ is the total of the chosen algos and return % is that total ÷ the combined capital of all chosen algos. In the older "Combine filtered algos" option, % is the average across the algos that traded each day. Max. Allocation is each algo's maximum capital as listed by Stratzy. Min. Allocation is the minimum capital listed by Stratzy for each algo. In the combined view both are sums across the chosen algos (Min. shows Not available if any chosen algo lacks it); in the combined view it is the sum for all chosen algos. Returns come from the Stratzy data supplied; past results don't guarantee future returns.
